description: This script manipulates NSLU2 firmware images, including packing and unpacking firmware files, managing partitions, and handling firmware components like RedBoot, Kernel, Ramdisk, and FIS directory. It includes functions for reading/writing firmware parts, layout management, and partition table creation.

methods.name: padBytes
methods.description: Pads input data to a specified total length with 0xFF bytes, used for flash memory erasure padding.

methods.name: paddedSize
methods.description: Calculates the next multiple of block size greater than or equal to a given data length.

methods.name: numBlocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of blocks needed to hold a given data length.

methods.name: createPartitionEntry
methods.description: Creates a binary partition entry with name, address, size, and optional skip regions.

methods.name: parsePartitionEntry
methods.description: Parses a binary partition entry into its components, returning name, offset, size, and skips.

methods.name: findPartitionTable
methods.description: Locates the partition table within firmware data if present.

methods.name: parsePartitionTable
methods.description: Parses a partition table into an array of partition info arrays.

methods.name: jffs2Block
methods.description: Creates an empty JFFS2 flash block.

methods.name: writeOut
methods.description: Writes data to a specified filename.

methods.name: trailerData
methods.description: Generates trailer data for firmware components (not used currently).

methods.name: printRedbootTrailer
methods.description: Prints detailed information from a RedBoot trailer.

methods.name: removeOptionalLoader
methods.description: Removes the Loader partition and adjusts Kernel and Ramdisk offsets.

methods.name: spliceFirmwarePartitions
methods.description: Populates partition info based on the firmware's partition table.

methods.name: layoutPartitions
methods.description: Verifies and assigns start/size to partitions, ensuring they fit in flash memory.

methods.name: buildPartitionTable
methods.description: Constructs binary partition table data from partition info.

methods.name: writeOutFirmware
methods.description: Assembles and writes the complete firmware image from partition data.

methods.name: checkPartitionTable
methods.description: Sanity checks the partition table data.

methods.name: printPartitions
methods.description: Prints a human-readable list of partitions.

methods.name: defaultPartitions
methods.description: Returns a default set of firmware partitions with predefined offsets and sizes.
